verdict.rationale: Airweave documents itself as an MCP *server* that lets external AI assistants query its data (airweave-docs-5, airweave-probe-3), and its integrations (auth-providers, connectors) are proprietary, not MCP-based consumption of external servers. There is no evidence Airweave itself acts as an MCP client that plugs in and uses tools from other MCP servers.
